title: MATO: Multi-objective Personalized Alignment with Test-time Optimization for Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2605.25342v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Aligning large language models (LLMs) with diverse and multifaceted user preferences is a fundamental challenge in personalized AI systems. Existing multi-objective alignment methods either rely on costly training or require pre-trained reward models for each preference, making it difficult for them to adapt to evolving preferences. Prompt-based personalization offers a training-free alternative, but prompting alone often provides limited steerability, as LLMs may overemphasize or overlook certain preferences and fail to give users reliable control over the relative importance of different objectives when conflicts arise, leading to suboptimal alignment. translated_title: MATO：基于测试时优化的大语言模型多目标个性化对齐
translated_abstract: 将大语言模型（LLM）与多样化、多方面的用户偏好对齐是个性化AI系统中的一项根本性挑战。现有的多目标对齐方法要么依赖昂贵的训练，要么需要为每种偏好预先训练奖励模型，这使其难以适应不断演变的偏好。基于提示的个性化提供了一种无需训练的替代方案，但仅靠提示往往只能提供有限的可控性：大语言模型可能过度强调或忽略某些偏好，且当目标之间发生冲突时，无法让用户可靠地控制不同目标的相对重要性，从而导致次优的对齐效果。在本文中，我们提出了MATO，这是一个无需训练的、基于测试时优化的多目标个性化对齐框架。MATO将个性化问题形式化为一个测试时优化问题，通过可控的权重来引导多个目标的相对重要性（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文提出MATO，一个无需训练的测试时优化框架，将大语言模型的多目标个性化对齐形式化为测试时优化问题，通过可控权重引导多个偏好目标之间的相对重要性，克服了现有方法训练成本高、难以适应偏好变化以及提示可控性不足的缺陷。
en_tdlr: MATO is a training-free framework that formulates multi-objective personalized alignment of LLMs as a test-time optimization problem, steering the relative importance of multiple preference objectives through controllable weights to overcome the limitations of costly training and limited prompt-based steerability.
